title: Interview Practice Study
body1:
This task is part of a research study conducted by Dr. Naama Ilany-Tzur at Carnegie Mellon University.

Purpose
The purpose of the research is to investigate how people interact with an AI agent during a practice job interview.

Procedure
First, you will answer a few short questions. You will then complete a practice behavioral interview in which an AI interviewer asks you five questions, which you answer by speaking out loud, and gives you feedback after each answer. Finally, you will answer a few questions about your experience. The expected duration of participation is about 25 to 30 minutes.

Participant Requirements
Participation in this study is limited to individuals age 18 and older. You will also need a computer with a microphone and a quiet place to speak.

Risk
The risks and discomfort associated with participation in this study are no greater than those ordinarily encountered in daily life or during other online activities. Receiving feedback on your answers may be mildly stressful or frustrating for some people. Specifically, there is the risk of disclosing personal information while interacting with the AI agent. Please do not disclose any personal information or identifiable information throughout this study. In case you do we will delete this information as soon as possible. If you feel any discomfort, you should end your participation immediately.

Benefits
There may be no personal benefit from your participation in the study but the knowledge received may be of value the general understanding of how users are interacting with AI agents and what affects this interaction.

Compensation & Costs
Upon completing your participation, you will be eligible for compensation as specified in Prolific (the online platform you were recruited through). The final page of this study shows a completion code. Copy that code and paste it into Prolific to receive your payment. There will be no cost to you if you participate in this study.

Future Use of Information
In the future once we have removed all identifiable information from your data, we may use it for our research studies, or we may distribute the data to other researchers for their research studies. We would do this without getting additional informed consent from you. Sharing of data with other researchers will only be done in such a manner that you will not be identified.

Confidentiality
The data captured for the research does not include any personally identifiable information about you. Your IP address will not be captured. The study will collect your research data through your use of a Salesforce web server. This company is not owned by CMU. The company will have access to the research data that you produce and any identifiable information that you share with them while using their product. Your messages to the AI agent are also sent to an AI service provider (OpenAI) so that the agent can reply. You will answer by speaking. Your web browser's speech-recognition service (for example, Google or Apple) converts your voice into text; we do not record or save your audio. Please note that CMU does not control the Terms and Conditions of these companies or how they will use or protect any information that they collect.

Right to Ask Questions & Contact Information
If you have any questions about this study, you should feel free to ask them by contacting the Principal Investigator now at nilanytz@andrew.cmu.edu. If you have questions later, desire additional information, or wish to withdraw your participation, please contact the Principal Investigator by e-mail in accordance with the contact information listed above.

If you have questions pertaining to your rights as a research participant, or you wish to report concerns, you should contact the Office of Research Integrity and Compliance at Carnegie Mellon University. Email: irb-review@andrew.cmu.edu. Phone: 412-268-4721. Use this phone number only if you have a question about your rights as a research participant or want to report a concern about this study. For questions about the tasks or your payment, please email the Principal Investigator instead.

Voluntary Participation
Your participation in this research is voluntary. You may discontinue participation at any time during the research activity. You may print a copy of this consent form for your records.
